COMPLETELY UNRELIABLE

We randomly found this firm (K Hemandas Real estate) while looking for options around Dadar, Mahim, Matunga etc. Initially they cracked the deal for us agreeing to all the conditions with the owner in a joint meeting a month before moving.
On the agreed date we paid the deposit when everything started falling apart. The owner asked for more deposit than agreed and the broker was also trying to convince us to pay him more. When we refused, the owner went back on his word to agree to any of the conditions.
The broker had to be constantly reminded of the conditions and even then the entire deal fell off near to the date of shifting. We are now still searching for a house and facing a lot of problems.

featured_reviews.name: George Santhosh
featured_reviews.review_text:
The building is not bad, but the surrounding locality is filthy and crowded. Garbage and rats are a common sight in the surrounding area. The roads leading to the building are narrow, filled with parked vehicles and people who do not step out of the way. Taxi drivers curse you for making them drop you here. The surrounding shops and structures are unpainted, gloomy and dilapidated. Reaching the railway station means you will have to take the bridge over the slums.

The lift system in the building is also very bad. Despite having three elevators in A-wing, their synchronisation is terrible. Men and women have different timings to access the gym. There is a termite problem in most flats. The only good part of the building are the neighbours, security and caretakers who are very kind.

featured_reviews.name: Atik Vora
featured_reviews.review_text: Newly constructed two wings tower each of 16 floors by the Evershine Group. Enough Parking and other amenities such as play area for kids and gymnasium for adults. 3) Hospitals, College, Schools and Market is not very far from the tower.
4) Few Minutes to the main highway road.
5) Few Minutes from Bandra Kurla Complex.
6) Bandra Terminus is also not very far which again adds upto Connectivity. Worth spending your hard earned money. Overall, one of the best place to live in Mumbai.
